# Stonic Voice (Beta) engine ke packages — scripts/setup-voice-runtime.js inhein
# voice-runtime/venv mein lagata hai.
#
# Har package ka version jama hua hai: ye wohi versions hain jin par Voice Lab
# (voice-lab/) aur engine ke test chale (12 Oct 2026). Naya version lena ho to
# pehle lab mein aazmao, phir yahan poori list dobara banao:
#
#   uv pip compile requirements.in -c <lab ka `uv pip freeze`> --python-version 3.11
#   requirements.in:  pipecat-ai[anthropic,google,webrtc]==1.12.0 / fastapi / uvicorn
#
# Install `--no-deps` se hota hai, kyunke chhe packages jaan bujh kar yahan NAHI:
#
#   numba, llvmlite, resampy     Pipecat ka doosra resampler; engine soxr istemal karta hai
#   opencv-python-headless       video ke liye; Beta mein sirf awaaz hai
#   sympy, mpmath                onnxruntime ke auzaar; model chalane mein nahi lagte
#
# Pipecat inhein apni zaroorat likhta hai magar awaaz ki pipeline inhein kabhi
# load nahi karti — asli baat-cheet ke dauran naapa hua (sys.modules), aur ye
# akele 268 MB hain (poore runtime ka aadha). stonic-computer/requirements.txt
# mein gui-agents ke saath yehi kiya gaya hai. Setup script install ke baad
# tests/selftest.py isi venv se chalata hai, taake koi zaroori cheez reh gayi
# ho to build wahin ruk jaye.
#
# Agent ka dimagh (13 Oct 2026; 5 Nov 2026 se dono voice assistants — New aur
# Classic — isi par): `claude-agent-sdk` aur us ke saathi — mcp,
# mcp-types, jsonschema (+ jsonschema-specifications, referencing, rpds-py),
# pyjwt, python-multipart, pywin32, sse-starlette. SDK ke andar Claude Code ki
# apni binary aati hai (`_bundled/claude.exe`, ~245 MB) — dimagh wohi process
# hai, is liye Node.js ki zaroorat nahi. Version badlo to stonic_voice/agent.py
# ke test (tests/agent_live.py) asli key ke saath dobara chalao.
